scope: Bilingual UI, silent desktop play and hosted artifact verification; no game rule or model simplification
fixedDuringReview: English titles and briefs overflowed the 1280 x 720 title menu
Narrow settings tabs were overlapped by the language selector
Close shared the wrong translation with the Off setting
Animated radio and objective copy needed translation before typewriter slicing
Weapon, core names and mission-debrief strings had incomplete coverage
A units-spacing rule split warehouses into wareho uses
A transparent location card intercepted Controls menu clicks
Reinforcement location and text needed a separator
Long English combat warnings overflowed; added bounded width and wrapping
observationOnlyIssues: A case-sensitive heading locator used Mission complete, while the actual translated heading was MISSION COMPLETE; direct UI inspection confirmed completion
Escape first released pointer lock during a no-QA startup test; P opened the paused menu
evidencePolicy: Intermediate reports retain their original hashes and are not relabeled as final-build runs. Raw diagnostic logs retain source-language event names; game presentation uses the selected language.
silentLimit: Sound mixing is not tested. No mobile touch gameplay, file protocol cold start or full performance acceptance is claimed.
